changes.comment: Drop WebGL1 support, WebGL2 is the minimum.
SSS transmission now works on WebGL2.
Sky SH projection uses seeded sample directions, so sky lighting is identical on every run.

Add discrete mesh levels of detail selected by projected screen size, generated with meshoptimizer at runtime (SharedModel.generateLods, shape LOD settings) and selected on the GPU for BatchGroup instances.
Add GPU frustum culling of BatchGroup instances.
Add a shared skin palette atlas, instanced skinned meshes, animation banks evaluated in a compute pass and gpuAnimation playback; add a subtree geometry instancing property.
Load KTX2/Basis textures, meshopt-compressed and quantized geometry and binary .zmsh primitives; Engine.init loads the build asset manifest.
Add wireframe and LOD coloration debug views gated by DEBUG_VIEWS; remove the per-mesh wireframe property.
Add procedural Bezier blade grass with clumping, two detail levels, wind sway, two-sided foliage transmission and cascaded shadows; sway card grass in the wind.
Light clustering: variable-length cluster light lists on WebGPU, spot cone and tile side plane culling, directional lights outside clusters, grid sized from the target resolution.
Fix sun bloom flicker, skinned mesh bounds, BatchGroup picking and orbit camera wheel zoom; reduce per-frame buffer allocation and TAA ghosting.
